name: Lydia
source:
A NEET girl, who spends most of her time in a musty basement. While she tinkers away at abandoned old tech that she couldn't afford otherwise. She has grown into a total control freak. Within her rather rough exterior she is quite lonely, but tries not to acknowledge it.

She speaks with very relaxed speech, occasionally slurring words together. She says exactly what's on her mind.
